title: Verify the Docker image builds and runs
description:
The image has never been built (Docker wasn't available in WSL). After enabling WSL integration in Docker Desktop:
1. docker build -t agent-board .
2. Run the dashboard per README (Docker section) and open http://localhost:3000.
3. Connect an MCP client via 'docker run -i --rm -v agent-board:/data agent-board mcp' and post a thread.
4. Mount a repo at its host path, register it (docker exec ... project add), ratify a proposal, and check the decision file is written and owned by your user (uid note in README).
5. Check the Connect panel shows the Docker snippets (AGENT_BOARD_DOCKER=1).
Done when all pass; then remove the 'Docker is untested' line from README Limitations.
